g.text: Held-out set: 8 question families, 16 bilingual queries per level, 6 document components from two textbooks.

text.style: font-size: 8.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #58616c

g.text: AI-authored variants and AI-reviewed labels; local document/topic holdout, not unseen-textbook or real-user validation.

text.style: font-size: 8.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #58616c

g.text: A–C exclude L4. D evaluates ambiguity separately. Point estimates only; paired component intervals are in the report.

text.style: font-size: 8.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #58616c

g.text: C uses one shared reranking request over the candidate union; each policy retains at most 20 candidates and a 1,024-token budget.

text.style: font-size: 8.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #58616c

g.text: Shared scoring is a controlled experiment, not a production request-budget or end-to-end latency measurement.
